name: pittig-finances
description: Simple finances for a small product business
author: Pittig

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron . --dev-server-url=http://localhost:5173"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.electron: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
